description: A FastAPI application demonstrating background task execution with dependency injection, featuring an endpoint to send notifications and log activities asynchronously.

methods.name: write_log(message: str)
methods.description: Writes a message to a log file.

methods.description: Endpoint to send notification email and add background log task.
